summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on September 4, 2026. Shareholders approved Proposals 1(a) and 2-4 as detailed in the prior proxy statement. The board composition was confirmed, including CEO Ofer Haviv. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no special-situation event, such as merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. The filing merely conveys meeting outcomes and the post-meeting board slate. No deal terms, recommendations, advisors, or strategic actions were disclosed. It qualifies as a routine current report, not a special situation.
